prompt:
In GA4, purchases doubled the day a new tag went live. GTM preview on the thank-you page shows two tags fired on the purchase event:
1. "GA4 - purchase" (GA4 Event, created this week, uses the ecommerce object)
2. "GA4 - purchase (old)" (GA4 Event, created last year, same event name, same measurement ID)
Which tag should be paused to stop the double count? Answer with only the tag name.

Trigger "Click - add to cart": All Elements click, Click Classes contains "add-to-cart".
The button on the page is: <button class="btn btn-primary addToCart" type="button">Add to cart</button>
Does the trigger fire when the button is clicked? Answer with only yes or no.

Lookup Table variable "LT - GA4 ID" uses input {{Page Hostname}}:
  shop.example.com -> G-TEST0001
  staging.example.com -> G-TEST0002
  default value -> G-TEST0000
A visitor is on https://www.example.com/pricing. Which measurement ID does the variable return? Answer with only the ID.

Trigger "PV - checkout steps": Page View where Page Path matches RegEx ^/checkout/step-[1-3]$
The visitor is on https://shop.example.com/checkout/step-4
Does the trigger fire? Answer with only yes or no.

The page pushes dataLayer.push({event: "sign_up"}) in an inline script above the GTM snippet, so the push happens before the container loads.
Trigger "CE - sign_up" is a Custom Event for sign_up. Does it fire once the container loads? Answer with only yes or no.

Consent Mode v2 is on. The tag "Ads - conversion" requires additional consent: ad_storage.
The visitor clicked "Reject all", so the consent state is ad_storage=denied, analytics_storage=denied.
Will the tag "Ads - conversion" fire as a normal tag? Answer with only yes or no.

The page source has two GTM snippets:
<script>(function(w,d,s,l,i){...})(window,document,'script','dataLayer','GTM-TEST001');</script>
<script>(function(w,d,s,l,i){...})(window,document,'script','dataLayer','GTM-TEST002');</script>
The first one is wrapped in <!-- ... --> HTML comment markers. Which container actually loads? Answer with only the container ID.
